The transition between the eyelid and the eyeball is very crisp, potentially indicating minor AI sharpening artifacts.

The black strap near the bottom right seems to merge into the fur without a clear buckle, ring, or attachment point. It appears to float or fade into the skin rather than sitting physically on top of it, suggesting a minor structural/logic error in how the equipment interacts with the subject.
